content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: IOB Vacancy 2026 covers a total of 291 posts across Generalist and Specialist Officer cadres in JMGS I, MMGS II, and MMGS III. Post Code 01 (Manager - Branch Management) is the Generalist Officer post; all other posts are Specialist Officer posts. The number of vacancies and reserved vacancies is provisional and may vary as per the Bank's actual requirements. Out of the 291 total posts, 12 vacancies are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWBD) on a horizontal basis: 4 for Hearing Impaired (HI), 5 for Orthopedically Challenged (OC), 2 for Visually Impaired (VI), and 1 for Intellectual Disability (ID).

content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility (age, educational qualification, and post-qualification work experience) is assessed as on 01.08.2026 for all posts. Candidates must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate from the Government of India for the latter categories). Certification requirements, technology-domain specifics, and detailed sub-conditions for each Specialist Officer post are extensive; candidates are advised to refer to the full official notification PDF for the complete post-wise qualification and experience matrix before applying.

content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in the following pay scales, with DA, HRA, CCA, and other allowances as per rules in force. Specialist Officers recruited laterally in MMG Scale II and III are also eligible for Conveyance Expenses, Newspaper Cost, Telephone/Mobile Expenses, Residential Furniture, and Bank-owned or leased accommodation during probation, as per extant Bank guidelines. content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment can be made online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or BHIM/UPI. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. For Post Code 01 (Manager – Branch Management): the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes) and Professional Knowledge – Banking Law & Practice, Indian Economy & Financial System, Principles & Practices of Banking, Accounting & Financial Management (75Q, 90 minutes). For all other posts: the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes), General Awareness with special reference to Banking Industry (25Q, 30 minutes), and Professional Knowledge, which varies post-wise (50Q, 60 minutes). There is no minimum qualifying mark for General Awareness and English Language; candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in Professional Knowledge. Minimum qualifying marks in the Online Examination: 35% for unreserved candidates, 30% for reserved candidates. 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for a wrong answer; there is no penalty for unattempted questions. The Interview carries a maximum of 100 marks, assessed on Role-related Industry Exposure, Subject Knowledge, and Communication Skills. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for unreserved, 45% for reserved candidates. The final merit list is prepared with 80% weightage to the Online Examination and 20% weightage to the Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official IOB website, www.iob.bank.in , and open the "Careers" page. Click on "Recruitment of Generalist/Specialist Officers in Various Scales – 2026-27" and select the post to be applied for. Click "Register Online" and complete first-time registration. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent via e-mail and SMS. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the prescribed specifications. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully and click "Complete Registration." Pay the applicable Application Fee / Intimation Charges online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/BHIM/UPI). Take a printout of the submitted application form and the payment e-receipt for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IOB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted online only, from 29.08.2026 to 15.09.2026; no other mode will be accepted. Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria for each. If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same post, only the last submitted application will be considered. Incomplete applications or those without supporting documents will be rejected outright. OBC candidates must submit a non-creamy layer certificate valid as on the date of interview. The Bank reserves the right to change, modify, cancel, or add to any of the eligibility or selection criteria. Outstation SC/ST/PWBD candidates who are unemployed will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route, as per Government guidelines. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Requests for change of examination centre, interview date, or registered e-mail ID will not be entertained. The Online Examination will be conducted at centres including Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/MMR/Thane, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q1. What is IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IOB Recruitment 2026 refers to Indian Overseas Bank's notification (Advt. No. HRDD/RECT/04/2026-27) for 291 Generalist and Specialist Officer posts in Scale I, II, and III.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 291 total vacancies across 14 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 15.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from a Graduation degree in any discipline (for Manager – Branch Management) to specific engineering, MCA, MBA (Finance), CA/CMA, or professional degrees for Specialist Officer posts. See the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post, ranging from 22–32 years to 30–45 years, assessed as on 01.08.2026. Age relaxation applies for SC/ST/OBC/PWBD/Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹175/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates and ₹1,000/- for all other candidates (including OBC and EWS), inclusive of GST.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the "Careers" page on www.iob.bank.in by registering online, filling the application form, uploading required documents, and paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an Online Examination followed by an Interview, with 80% weightage to the exam and 20% to the interview in the final merit list.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IOB Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay scales range from ₹48,480 (JMGS I) to ₹1,05,280 (MMGS III), plus DA, HRA, CCA, and other allowances as applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one post in IOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for more than one post, provided they fulfil the eligibility criteria for each post applied for.
